title: Bulgaria's Biennial Transparency Report 2024 under the Paris Agreement
temporal_coverage: Observed climate and hydrology across source-stated historical periods; future climate-health vulnerabilities; adaptation institutions through 2024.
methodology: Government BTR compiles national climate, hydrological and sector evidence.
limitations: Periods vary; future projections are uncertain.

title: Overlooked: Examining the Impact of Disasters and Climate Shocks on Poverty in the Europe and Central Asia Region
temporal_coverage: Bulgaria case study of the June 2014 flood, published in a 2021 regional report.
methodology: World Bank regional poverty and disaster report; Bulgaria's case box synthesizes cited event sources.
limitations: The Bulgaria box cites secondary references and does not reproduce an underlying local assessment.

title: Disasters, Accidents, Incidents and Crises in 2024: Final Data
temporal_coverage: Final event and expenditure statistics for 2024, with selected comparisons to 2023.
methodology: Official NSI release presenting final annual counts of crisis events, declared disasters, geographic coverage and public expenditure.
limitations: Categories include non-climate crises and accidents; the release does not attribute events to climate change or disaggregate household impacts.

title: The Water Crises of Bulgaria: Analysis and Solutions (Summary)
temporal_coverage: Climate observations include 1991–2020; water-sector indicators are reported as current in the March 2026 summary; irrigation figures include 2024.
methodology: MOEW minister/deputy-minister report summary drawing on climate observations and water-sector/operator statistics.
limitations: Summary-level government analysis; figures use varied periods and some operator records are not externally verifiable.

title: Country Report Bulgaria 2026 (Staff Working Document and Annexes)
organization: European Commission, Directorate-General for Economic and Financial Affairs
temporal_coverage: 2026 country analysis; mixed indicators from 2013–2025 and adaptation programming for 2021–2027.
methodology: European Commission country staff working document synthesizing Bulgarian and EU indicators, policy documents and implementation evidence; Annex 10 addresses adaptation and preparedness.
limitations: Indicators use different reference periods; reported plans and coverage are not household-level outcome measurements.
